semiconductor_relevance: High — Akribis Systems specializes in precision motion control systems that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Akribis Systems (Shanghai) Co., Ltd designs and manufactures high-precision direct drive motors and motion control systems tailored for high-speed applications in the semiconductor industry. Their products enhance productivity and accuracy in manufacturing processes across various sectors, including semiconductor fabrication.
capabilities: Direct drive motors (linear, rotary, voice coil)
